dishes.name: Augsburger Zwetschgendatschi
dishes.desc: Flat plum cake on a thin dough base, baked on a tray in September and October. The signature cake of Augsburg and Bavarian Swabia.

dishes.name: Bubenspitzle
dishes.desc: Finger-shaped potato noodles fried in butter, served with sauerkraut and bacon. A homely staple of Swabian kitchens around Augsburg.

dishes.name: Krautkrapfen
dishes.desc: Dough pockets filled with seasoned cabbage and bacon, baked or fried. A rustic Bavarian Swabian dish of the Lech and Danube villages.

dishes.name: Zwiebelrostbraten
dishes.desc: Pan-fried beef roast topped with fried onions in gravy, served with Spätzle. A standard of Swabian inns in the Augsburg area.
